claims.effectType: Preserve raw type and map capabilities; type label contributes no scalar quality or rank effect.
claims.boundaries: Do not infer service level, privacy, legality, safety, luxury or fit from a commercial type label.
claims.testIdea: Rename an otherwise identical offer across type labels and require decision attributes to remain invariant.

claims.historyNotes: extends StaySolution identity to non-hotel sellable spaces
claims.effectType: Reject or quarantine evidence joins that do not match property, sellable space, offer, stay and party scope.
claims.boundaries: Property-level evidence cannot automatically apply to every apartment, room, bed, pitch or offer.
claims.testIdea: Swap the exact room, bed or pitch while holding property fixed and verify scoped evidence detaches.

claims.effectType: Display only a qualified scheme label; prohibit a global star conversion.
claims.boundaries: A numeric grade has meaning only inside its named scheme, type, edition and jurisdiction.
claims.testIdea: Cross-scheme fixtures with identical numeric stars must never be merged into one universal quality value.

claims.effectType: Use facet ranges or recheck when an exact physical unit is not guaranteed.
claims.boundaries: Do not infer exact view, floor, bed, pitch position or equipment from sample media or category labels.
claims.testIdea: Remove an exact-unit guarantee and require confidence to fall or ranges to widen without inventing a representative unit.

claims.historyNotes: extends canonicalization to multi-unit and multi-space inventory
claims.effectType: Build a probabilistic entity graph and abstain from ambiguous merges.
claims.boundaries: Similar names are not proof of identity and different marketing names are not proof of difference.
claims.testIdea: One building with two distinct units plus one cross-provider alias must resolve to one property and two units.

claims.historyNotes: extends true-cost integrity to non-hotel charges
claims.effectType: Compute mandatory total and cash schedule while reporting refundable holds and contingent exposure separately.
claims.boundaries: A separately collected fee is not automatically optional and a refundable deposit is not expected spend.
claims.testIdea: Move cost between nightly rate and mandatory cleaning fee and require mandatory total invariance.

claims.effectType: Represent explicit rule conflicts as eligibility or friction candidates after party matching.
claims.boundaries: Do not infer strictness, friendliness or hostility from writing tone.
claims.testIdea: A no-pets rule must exclude a party with a pet and leave an otherwise identical no-pet party unaffected.

claims.effectType: Match each space independently to explicit privacy and access needs.
claims.boundaries: Private room does not imply private bathroom, entrance, kitchen or whole-stay privacy.
claims.testIdea: Mutate only bathroom privacy and require only bathroom-related evidence and fit to change.

claims.effectType: Expose a personalized privacy-support-social trade-off only after explicit profile evidence.
claims.boundaries: Do not infer desired sociability from age, nationality, solo status or accommodation type.
claims.testIdea: Move the host off-site and test opposite effects for profiles explicitly preferring privacy versus on-site support.

claims.effectType: Apply a temporal feasibility check and target unknown fallback details for recheck.
claims.boundaries: Self check-in or reception does not imply 24-hour feasible access.
claims.testIdea: Delay arrival beyond staffed hours and require feasibility only when a verified fallback exists.

claims.effectType: Propagate coordinate uncertainty into distance and travel-time intervals.
claims.boundaries: Approximate pins do not support exact building, distance, micro-location or route claims; location verification does not verify descriptions.
claims.testIdea: Increase location uncertainty radius and require wider route intervals and lower exact-distance confidence.

claims.effectType: Represent concrete cooking, food-storage and wash-dry task coverage instead of binary amenity flags.
claims.boundaries: Kitchenette does not imply a full kitchen and laundry available does not imply private, included or usable service.
claims.testIdea: Remove the hob and require a cooking-dependent long stay to fail while a one-night non-cooking stay remains unaffected.

claims.effectType: Evaluate sleeping and layout feasibility separately from nominal capacity.
claims.boundaries: Sleeps N does not prove N comparable beds, bedrooms, bathrooms, privacy or accessibility.
claims.testIdea: Replace two beds with a sofa-bed while preserving nominal capacity and require layout evidence to change.

claims.historyNotes: extends accessibility to every non-hotel sellable space
claims.effectType: Use conjunctive feature-and-route matching plus targeted verification for critical unknowns.
claims.boundaries: Generic accessible labels and self-reported fields do not establish legal compliance or exact-unit usability.
claims.testIdea: An accessible unit with an inaccessible route to a required facility must fail the end-to-end need.

claims.effectType: Use provenance to decide evidence sufficiency, recheck or abstention; do not create an opaque safety score.
claims.boundaries: Platform presence, badges, reviews or missing optional fields cannot prove safety, compliance or violation.
claims.testIdea: Remove verified evidence but retain listing prose and require unknown confidence rather than pass or fail imputation.

claims.effectType: Retain historical reliability only with entity scope, recency and platform-rule provenance.
claims.boundaries: Profile photo, name, prose, badge or another managed property cannot guarantee exact-unit future performance.
claims.testIdea: Move a unit to a new manager and require prior manager evidence to detach or downgrade.

claims.historyNotes: extends evidence provenance to bilateral P2P reviews
claims.effectType: Keep review systems separate unless an explicit calibrated transform exists.
claims.boundaries: Scores and counts from different systems do not have automatically equal meaning.
claims.testIdea: Remove review-system metadata and require the aggregate to become non-comparable rather than silently merged.

claims.effectType: Represent uncertainty and within-system context; tiny decimal gaps get no automatic meaning.
claims.boundaries: A high compressed average is not precise latent quality and historical findings are not current-listing guarantees.
claims.testIdea: Compare equal means at n=8 and n=800 and require different confidence without forced quality ordering.

claims.effectType: Expose aspect evidence, contradictions and recheck triggers without importing aspect weights.
claims.boundaries: Absence of a complaint does not prove feature presence, function or lack of failure.
claims.testIdea: Hold overall rating fixed while adding repeated recent access failures and require access evidence to change.

claims.effectType: Use a shared crosswalk plus type-specific aspect extensions and out-of-distribution checks.
claims.boundaries: Topic prevalence and model salience are not individual utility weights.
claims.testIdea: Audit a hotel-only extractor on hostel and camping corpora for lost security, social, pitch and nature aspects.

claims.effectType: Exclude host and manager portraits from decision features and proxy pipelines.
claims.boundaries: Never infer honesty, competence, personality, protected traits or reliability from appearance.
claims.testIdea: Replace only the host portrait and require every decision output to remain invariant.

claims.effectType: Treat breakfast as an exact-offer service with temporal feasibility and explicit uncertainty.
claims.boundaries: B&B does not imply complimentary, full, hot, timely or allergen-safe breakfast.
claims.testIdea: Move departure before breakfast service and require the benefit to disappear unless an alternative is verified.

claims.effectType: Create a per-stay service calendar and cumulative exposure record; no service weight yet.
claims.boundaries: Serviced does not imply daily hotel service and apartment does not imply no service.
claims.testIdea: Change cleaning from daily to weekly and compare 3-night versus 28-night service calendars.

claims.historyNotes: extends length-of-stay logic to non-hotel utility and friction
claims.effectType: Compute exposure counts and scenarios only; learn any preference effects from StayOpti outcomes.
claims.boundaries: Longer is not universally worse and serviced apartments are not automatically best for long stays.
claims.testIdea: Replay 2 and 21 nights and verify laundry benefits and repeated noise or no-cleaning friction scale separately.

claims.effectType: Canonicalize and validate the exact bed or private-room offer separately from the hostel property.
claims.boundaries: Hostel name does not imply private room, chosen bunk or same-room placement for a group.
claims.testIdea: Swap a 4-bed dorm offer for a 12-bed dorm offer and require product evidence to change while property evidence stays.

claims.effectType: Match concrete personal-security requirements and preserve unknowns instead of one vague score.
claims.boundaries: Price, nationality, dorm type or reviews cannot establish objective neighborhood or personal safety probability.
claims.testIdea: A laptop larger than the locker must invalidate nominal locker coverage for that task.

claims.effectType: Expose social-versus-quiet trade-off only after explicit traveler evidence.
claims.boundaries: Solo, young or backpacker labels do not imply a desire to party or socialize.
claims.testIdea: Use paired explicit profiles for social events and early sleep and allow fit to invert without demographic proxies.

claims.effectType: Apply an interval-based temporal feasibility gate for arrival and planned activities.
claims.boundaries: Self check-in or central location does not prove no curfew or unrestricted night access.
claims.testIdea: Delay a flight beyond latest check-in and require recheck or failure unless fallback is evidenced.

claims.effectType: Use geometric and equipment compatibility as eligibility evidence, with ranges for pitch classes.
claims.boundaries: Camping pitch does not imply compatibility with every tent, caravan or motorhome.
claims.testIdea: Increase vehicle length across the pitch or route boundary and require ineligibility despite unchanged occupancy.

claims.effectType: Check equipment compatibility and required-facility routes as separate capabilities.
claims.boundaries: Water point does not imply potable, electric does not imply full hookup, and bathroom does not imply private sanitation.
claims.testIdea: Change connector or amperage while retaining an electric-hookup label and require incompatibility to be detected.

claims.effectType: Trigger time-bounded recheck or abstention on material official hazard or closure evidence.
claims.boundaries: Do not infer unsafe from regional stereotypes or safe from normal historical climate.
claims.testIdea: Inject an official warning after capture and require dynamic suspension without rewriting static quality.

claims.effectType: Represent glamping as a facet vector; the word itself has no quality or rank effect.
claims.boundaries: Glamping does not guarantee hotel-equivalent luxury, private plumbing, climate control or all-weather use.
claims.testIdea: Rename a basic tent as luxury glamping without changing facets and require output invariance.

claims.effectType: Compute the party-specific usable facility set for the exact dates and offer.
claims.boundaries: A property-level facility icon does not prove inclusion, operation, capacity or party usability.
claims.testIdea: Close a kids club for exact dates and require family usable facilities to change while property catalogue stays fixed.

claims.effectType: Include mandatory fee in total while evaluating any benefits separately and preventing double count.
claims.boundaries: On-site collection does not imply optional and fee price does not establish benefit value.
claims.testIdea: Repartition the same total between room and resort fee and require total-cost invariance.

claims.historyNotes: extends V3 abstention to type-specific critical evidence
claims.effectType: Queue targeted recheck and abstain when unresolved plausible values can reverse eligibility or the decision.
claims.boundaries: Unknown is neither present nor absent; never impute safety, privacy, accessibility or mandatory cost from a type average.
claims.testIdea: Evaluate every plausible value and require abstention whenever the candidate choice flips before resolution.

claims.boundaries: general multi-attribute tasks; no travel-optimal card threshold
claims.testIdea: randomize shortlist depth; score blind decision quality, effort, abandonment and trade-off recall

claims.boundaries: high heterogeneity across products, tasks and moderators
claims.testIdea: factorial card-count by complexity by profile; reject fixed overload threshold

claims.boundaries: moderators do not supply ready travel cutoffs
claims.testIdea: measure value-of-information and winner flip per adaptive question against burden

claims.boundaries: limited experimental product domains
claims.testIdea: hold card count fixed; vary information structure; test errors, time and missing-data comprehension

claims.boundaries: no direct estimate of economic cost of waiting for hotels
claims.testIdea: compare forced choice and abstention on later regret, violations and recovery quality

claims.boundaries: effect magnitude and ecology vary
claims.testIdea: add/remove dominated options and shuffle order; latent scores and unrelated roles must remain invariant

claims.boundaries: reference point must be observed or uncertainty-labelled
claims.testIdea: inject legitimate versus irrelevant anchors; only provenance-backed references may affect sensitivity

claims.boundaries: cross-domain mean is not an individual travel parameter; active debate
claims.testIdea: sweep coefficient ranges and require winner robustness; calibrate only on consented comparable behavior

claims.boundaries: abstract ambiguity paradigm; no hotel risk premium
claims.testIdea: remove cancellation data; system must mark unknown or recheck, never silently map to non-refundable

claims.boundaries: self-report scale is not hotel-specific
claims.testIdea: within-user cross-domain divergence and stability by trip purpose; prohibit demographic proxying

claims.boundaries: review does not define a hotel cancellation curve
claims.testIdea: lead-time and deadline counterfactuals tied to realized cancellations and rebook outcomes

claims.boundaries: gambling experiments; regret minimization is not always safety
claims.testIdea: vary counterfactual feedback and collect cause-specific anticipated and realized regret

claims.boundaries: lottery choice experiment; privacy-sensitive considered set
claims.testIdea: measure stay satisfaction and decision regret separately; test predictive validity for reuse and override

claims.boundaries: brand-product generalization; hotel seasonality and parity require new evidence
claims.testIdea: leak dates, room or flexibility from peer set; invalid anchors must be rejected

claims.boundaries: mental accounts vary; no universal partition
claims.testIdea: repartition identical total between now/later and fees; economic ranking must remain total-cost invariant

claims.boundaries: mean hypothetical bias does not transfer to hotels or persons
claims.testIdea: holdout calibration of stated versus revealed WTP with selection-bias audit

claims.boundaries: single-property stated-choice study; no universal magnitudes
claims.testIdea: hierarchical subgroup model with cold-start abstention, calibration and fairness checks

claims.boundaries: dated couple experiment; influence is culture- and context-sensitive
claims.testIdea: compare average, least-misery and consensus while preserving accessibility and other hard vetoes

claims.boundaries: country and period specific; family forms under-covered
claims.testIdea: measure proxy error and decision improvement from one conflict-targeted question versus burden

claims.boundaries: small destination-choice study; destination is not hotel
claims.testIdea: simulate and field-test aggregation rules on minimum, mean and dispersion of satisfaction/regret

claims.boundaries: much evidence from safety-critical automation
claims.testIdea: compare reliance against measured capability; score misuse and disuse, not trust alone

claims.boundaries: forecast tasks; adoption is not outcome quality
claims.testIdea: longitudinal recovery after visible error across objective and subjective tasks; score choice quality

claims.boundaries: forecast evidence; control can reduce accuracy
claims.testIdea: compare no control, bounded critique and free override on accuracy, adoption, burden and regret

claims.boundaries: operational domains are higher stakes than travel
claims.testIdea: inject fluent but constraint-violating recommendations; independent governor must block them

claims.boundaries: review and studies in non-travel recommenders
claims.testIdea: detect persuasion-quality divergence using sacrifice recall, factuality and error correction

claims.boundaries: single educational field context; transparency effect is non-monotonic
claims.testIdea: factorial explanation depth by expectation violation; measure load, correction and outcome quality

claims.boundaries: public facts and numbers, not hotel recommendations
claims.testIdea: compare verbal label, numeric range and range-plus-cause on comprehension, trust and decision quality

claims.boundaries: requires defined events, enough outcomes and distribution-shift monitoring
claims.testIdea: Brier and reliability by role and segment with holdout, intervals and calibration-drift alarms

claims.boundaries: heterogeneous domains; choice share does not establish welfare
claims.testIdea: randomize badge/default; require outcome or regret benefit, commission neutrality and informed override

claims.boundaries: not a universal quality scalar
claims.testIdea: scheme-swap monotonicity

claims.boundaries: neither channel substitutes for the other
claims.testIdea: classification-review conflict set

claims.boundaries: coefficients do not transport automatically
claims.testIdea: hierarchical out-of-context holdout

claims.boundaries: no cross-dimension masking of severe failures
claims.testIdea: 2x2 physical-service scenarios

claims.boundaries: Kano class is context dependent
claims.testIdea: re-estimated penalty-reward curves

claims.boundaries: missing is not failure
claims.testIdea: severity-recency false-positive audit

claims.boundaries: property feature does not prove offered-room feature
claims.testIdea: room-feature swap

claims.boundaries: self-report; no universal mattress rule
claims.testIdea: sensitivity-by-duration prospective outcome

claims.boundaries: WHO values are not hotel-room thresholds
claims.testIdea: noise-source ablation

claims.boundaries: no universal ideal setpoint
claims.testIdea: season-climate interaction

claims.boundaries: request is not guarantee
claims.testIdea: bed-layout mutation

claims.boundaries: category alone cannot establish bathroom fit
claims.testIdea: exact-feature missing-vs-false

claims.boundaries: IEQ hotel weights are weak
claims.testIdea: facet ablation

claims.boundaries: under-researched does not mean unimportant
claims.testIdea: planned-vs-actual-use

claims.boundaries: no amenity-count bonus
claims.testIdea: unused-amenity invariance

claims.boundaries: no universal employee coefficient
claims.testIdea: service-dimension isolation

claims.boundaries: present does not mean usable
claims.testIdea: presence-condition cross-product

claims.boundaries: generic accessible label insufficient
claims.testIdea: expert-reviewed access matrix

claims.boundaries: US law not globally portable
claims.testIdea: booking-path and arrival-mismatch tests

claims.boundaries: individual preference overrides segment
claims.testIdea: explicit-preference override fairness

claims.boundaries: family is heterogeneous
claims.testIdea: age-layout scenario suite

claims.boundaries: business label alone sets no weight
claims.testIdea: purpose-only residual test

claims.boundaries: no traveler-label utility
claims.testIdea: group-label counterfactual fairness

claims.boundaries: no blanket LoS penalty
claims.testIdea: repeated-exposure simulation

claims.boundaries: length is not truth
claims.testIdea: human accuracy with LoS-length ablation

claims.boundaries: overall score and non-mention are insufficient
claims.testIdea: aspect annotation and explanation faithfulness

claims.boundaries: raw scores not cross-context comparable
claims.testIdea: cross-platform-city temporal holdout

claims.boundaries: mention count is not prevalence
claims.testIdea: count-vs-rate empirical-Bayes calibration

claims.boundaries: missing is not automatically bad
claims.testIdea: coverage-vs-hard-need-error curve

claims.boundaries: do not force scalar winner under preference-sensitive trade-off
claims.testIdea: preference-reversal and explanation-completeness

claims.effectType: Infer and explain a local night-specific regime only; never import a national/month label.
claims.boundaries: Official regions are contextual and may remain too coarse; no universal seasonal threshold.
claims.testIdea: Compare city-wide and microzone models under leave-one-microzone-out validation.

claims.effectType: Use type/category-aware baselines or hierarchical interactions.
claims.boundaries: Direction is supported but effect size varies by market and classification system.
claims.testIdea: Pooled-versus-stratified temporal/geographic holdout with calibration by type.

claims.effectType: Infer per night, then aggregate; permit MIXED for heterogeneous stays.
claims.boundaries: A provider total cannot be allocated to nights without source allocation or an explicit uncertainty-bearing model.
claims.testIdea: Construct stays crossing weekday, weekend and event nights and verify the per-night trace survives aggregation.

claims.effectType: Condition price/availability distributions and booking pace on search date and lead time.
claims.boundaries: No universal early, normal or late booking band.
claims.testIdea: Lead-time ablation plus rolling-origin evaluation at multiple horizons.

claims.effectType: Model a distribution of price paths; prohibit deterministic book-early/book-late rules.
claims.boundaries: Posted rates can be uniform, increasing, decreasing or irregular; market and offer scope matter.
claims.testIdea: Hold out properties/stay dates and score predicted change direction and interval coverage.

claims.effectType: Compare only compatible channel/room/rate products or model terms explicitly.
claims.boundaries: Same property and date do not imply the same product.
claims.testIdea: Inject channel, cancellation, meal and fee mismatches and require cohort rejection.

claims.effectType: Build versioned compatible cohorts, with explicit hierarchical fallback.
claims.boundaries: Widening geography or product definitions can create false cheap/expensive signals.
claims.testIdea: Leave-cohort-out evaluation and adversarial inclusion of incompatible peers.

claims.effectType: Report a timestamped interval/percentile against compatible observations, not a timeless mean.
claims.boundaries: Averages can conceal multimodality, dynamic pricing and sold-out selection.
claims.testIdea: Compare mean-only versus distributional forecasts under regime and stale-history stress tests.

claims.effectType: Preserve granular availability states and infer sold out only from explicit evidence.
claims.boundaries: Empty or missing provider responses are observationally ambiguous.
claims.testIdea: Replay provider outage, stop-sell, minimum-stay and true sold-out cases.

claims.effectType: Restrict inference to observed supply or apply an explicitly validated censoring model.
claims.boundaries: Available-only price panels cannot identify the missing supply or latent demand distribution.
claims.testIdea: Simulate known latent demand with capacity closure and quantify available-only bias.

claims.effectType: Estimate latent demand only with uncertainty and model-assumption disclosure.
claims.boundaries: Unconstraining methods are assumption-sensitive and need not be identifiable from public rates.
claims.testIdea: Synthetic recovery under varying substitution, censoring and misspecification.

claims.effectType: Compute booking-pace residuals only versus comparable historical curves.
claims.boundaries: A raw pickup count is not intrinsically fast or slow across markets and seasons.
claims.testIdea: Apply wrong-weekday, wrong-season and wrong-type curves and verify degradation/abstention.

claims.effectType: Use official holidays/school calendars as versioned covariates, not labels.
claims.boundaries: Demand effects depend on origin population, destination and year; causal magnitude is not universal.
claims.testIdea: Shift dates/jurisdictions and perform feature ablation on held-out years.

claims.effectType: Require attributable local excess before emitting EVENT_SPIKE.
claims.boundaries: Events can have small, null or heterogeneous hotel effects.
claims.testIdea: Fake, cancelled and empirically null events must not produce EVENT_SPIKE.

claims.effectType: Estimate event exposure and lift per night and geographic catchment.
claims.boundaries: Simple city membership or straight-line distance may miss transport and venue-specific exposure.
claims.testIdea: Relocate venue, permute event days and use distance/catchment interactions in holdout.

claims.effectType: Use multi-treatment attribution or abstain when event effects are not separately identifiable.
claims.boundaries: Reviewed single-event designs do not establish identification under dense overlaps.
claims.testIdea: Simulate co-located events with correlated timing and evaluate attribution/UNKNOWN rate.

claims.effectType: Model local weekday interactions; prohibit a fixed weekend premium/discount.
claims.boundaries: Signs and magnitudes can reverse across business, leisure and event markets.
claims.testIdea: Geographic holdout including business/leisure destination reversal.

claims.effectType: Allow climate normals as long-run context only.
claims.boundaries: Normals do not predict weather on a specific future stay night.
claims.testIdea: Schema and feature-lineage assertion rejects use of a normal as an issued night forecast.

claims.effectType: Admit weather only if it adds calibrated out-of-sample value beyond calendar and booking pace.
claims.boundaries: Climate/tourism effects vary by destination type and are not necessarily causal at hotel-night level.
claims.testIdea: Weather ablation, wrong-issue-time leakage and wrong-grid adversarial tests.

claims.effectType: Evaluate partial pooling/global related-series models for sparse markets and new properties.
claims.boundaries: General forecasting evidence does not prove hotel-domain transfer or one model family.
claims.testIdea: Leave-one-city, microzone, property and accommodation-type-out evaluation.

claims.effectType: Reconcile property, microzone and city forecasts when the measures truly aggregate.
claims.boundaries: Reconciliation cannot repair incompatible channels, cohorts or definitions and does not guarantee accuracy.
claims.testIdea: Break aggregation definitions and require gate failure; compare coherent forecast accuracy.

claims.effectType: Emit label probabilities, intervals and confidence; evaluate with proper scores and coverage.
claims.boundaries: A proper score does not choose the business decision threshold or ensure subgroup calibration.
claims.testIdea: CRPS/log/Brier and empirical coverage by market, type, lead time and label.

claims.effectType: Require rolling-origin plus geographic/property/event holdouts for promotion evidence.
claims.boundaries: Random row splits leak repeated properties, stay dates and future information.
claims.testIdea: Quantify random-split optimism versus rolling-origin and leave-group-out results.

claims.effectType: Trigger UNKNOWN, quarantine or frozen fallback when drift exits the validated envelope.
claims.boundaries: Detector thresholds are local; an alarm is not automatic permission to retrain or relabel.
claims.testIdea: Abrupt, gradual, recurring and provider-schema drift with false-alarm measurement.

claims.effectType: Make replayable provenance a hard gate for every feature and inference.
claims.boundaries: Provenance records support audit but do not establish accuracy or legal permission by themselves.
claims.testIdea: Hash, version and lineage mutation must break deterministic replay and fail the gate.

claims.effectType: Exclude data and dependent features when lawful-use metadata is absent, expired or incompatible.
claims.boundaries: This report is not legal advice; provider and jurisdiction facts control.
claims.testIdea: Expired licence, prohibited model-training purpose and deletion-request propagation tests.

claims.effectType: Exclude incomplete-price offers from price-regime estimation or mark them non-comparable.
claims.boundaries: Mandatory charge treatment and presentation can vary by jurisdiction and provider context.
claims.testIdea: Hidden-fee, FX-time and per-night/total inconsistency mutations.

claims.effectType: Emit MIXED with a per-night explanation when regimes materially differ or signals conflict.
claims.boundaries: Materiality must be locally defined and pre-registered; no universal spread threshold.
claims.testIdea: Multi-night event/non-event and weekday/weekend stays; ensure averaging cannot erase the difference.

claims.effectType: Return UNKNOWN when evidence, identification, provenance, calibration or distributional support fails.
claims.boundaries: UNKNOWN must not be silently imputed into LOW/NORMAL/HIGH.
claims.testIdea: Missing, corrupted, censored, stale and out-of-distribution cases must abstain at expected rates.

claims.effectType: Use labels and confidence for explanation/shadow trace only; assert zero ranking influence.
claims.boundaries: This is a v1.1 governance constraint, not evidence that labels improve traveler outcomes.
claims.testIdea: Differential execution with the module enabled/disabled must produce identical scores, order and winner.

claims.boundaries: price is not quality and not stable
claims.testIdea: same intrinsic hotel, altered time/channel/terms

claims.boundaries: no universal earlier/later rule
claims.testIdea: competing monotonic rules must fail on irregular paths

claims.boundaries: month labels and low-season cutoffs are not global
claims.testIdea: cross-region/month reversal and event override

claims.boundaries: one best forecasting method is not defensible
claims.testIdea: rolling-origin error, calibration and change-point suite

claims.boundaries: stars alone do not define a comp set
claims.testIdea: adversarial cheap peer with incompatible terms/system

claims.boundaries: isolated market average is invalid evidence
claims.testIdea: mean distorted by skew/outlier versus robust distribution

claims.boundaries: mandatory stay total still excludes access and optional spend
claims.testIdea: hidden resort/cleaning/tax fee flips ranking

claims.boundaries: money-time conversion is traveler/context specific
claims.testIdea: cheaper room becomes worse after repeated access burden

claims.boundaries: radius is only a weak proxy; no universal value/km
claims.testIdea: equal radius but different door-to-door time/network

claims.boundaries: published minute-equivalents cannot be ported
claims.testIdea: same clock time with direct versus transfer route

claims.boundaries: no universal fair flexibility premium
claims.testIdea: flexible offer wins only under plausible disruption states

claims.boundaries: refundable is not a sufficient boolean
claims.testIdea: two refundable offers with materially different deadlines/penalties

claims.boundaries: no universal TTL; recheck is not proof of future availability
claims.testIdea: candidate winner changes after stale-price update

claims.boundaries: model-specific latent quality, not ground truth
claims.testIdea: raw mean versus calibrated shrinkage on held-out outcomes

claims.boundaries: risk indicators cannot label a specific review fake
claims.testIdea: same rating/count under different collection mechanisms

claims.boundaries: count cannot erase systematic bias; no universal enough-count
claims.testIdea: high-volume biased sample versus smaller verified sample

claims.boundaries: business/leisure labels do not fix utility
claims.testIdea: within-segment preference reversals and cold-start abstention

claims.boundaries: direct causal lodging evidence is sparse; no long-stay cutoff
claims.testIdea: duplicate nights while separating fixed from recurring utility

claims.boundaries: no direct validated hotel-switch coefficient
claims.testIdea: same monetary saving across solo/light versus family/heavy-luggage cases

claims.boundaries: no universal minimum saving or max moves
claims.testIdea: recommend only if lower-bound net value remains positive

claims.boundaries: external coefficients are priors only
claims.testIdea: temporal/geographic holdout, subgroup calibration and policy rollback
